items.briefing:
Australian education platform Mathspace has suffered a significant data breach affecting more than one million students, parents, and teachers. Personal information has been exposed, making this directly relevant to schools and training organisations across the country — including anyone using Mathspace for student learning. If your organisation uses this platform, check whether your staff or students are affected and be alert for follow-up phishing attempts using the stolen details.

Separately, AI-powered scams are becoming increasingly convincing and harder to detect. Staff should be cautious of unexpected emails, calls, or messages — even if they seem highly personalised or legitimate.

**Tip:** If you use Mathspace, notify affected students and staff promptly and remind them to be suspicious of any unusual contact referencing their personal details.

featured.title: Mathspace breach exposed data of more than 1 million students, parents and teachers
